newsitem.title: USA: Storage USA Inc holder adds to stake.
newsitem.headline: Storage USA Inc holder adds to stake.

text.p: Storage USA Inc said on Thursday it sold 851,000 shares of its common stock to Security Capital Holdings SA, a wholly owned subsidiary of Security Capital U.S. Realty.

The shares were sold at $37.625 per share in a direct placement pursuant to the company's agreement with Security Capital, which now holds 10.1 million, or 37 percent, of the company's outstanding common stock, Storage USA said.
The total proceeds of $32 million will be used to repay debt that its partnerships incurred to buy self-storage facilities, Storage USA said.
The sale to US Realty and previous stock sales through Goldman Sachs & Co have raised $90 million in new equity for the company, Storage USA said.
